Good — I need to require a clean 12-month baseline (no prior ULT before index) and 12-month follow-up. Let me require an observation period covering baseline + follow-up, then compute flare and uric-acid-control rates. I'll restrict to the ~20,300 allopurinol vs 1,185 febuxostat single-drug initiators.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH ult AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date,
    CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id = 1167322 THEN 'allopurinol' ELSE 'febuxostat' END AS drug
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1167322, 19017742)
),
first_ult AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(start_date) AS index_date FROM ult GROUP BY person_id
),
first_drug AS (
  SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, MIN(u.drug) AS drug
  FROM first_ult f
  JOIN ult u ON u.person_id = f.person_id AND u.start_date = f.index_date
  GROUP BY f.person_id, f.index_date
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT u.drug) = 1
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT fd.person_id, fd.index_date, fd.drug
  FROM first_drug fd
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = fd.person_id
  WHERE op.observation_period_start_date <= DATEADD(day, -365, fd.index_date)
    AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day, 365, fd.index_date)
)
SELECT drug, COUNT(*) AS eligible_n
FROM eligible GROUP BY drug ORDER BY drug

Now I'll compute the two 12-month outcomes for each cohort in one query: gout-flare code incidence within 365 days post-index, and uric acid control (any serum urate <6 mg/dL) within 365 days.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH ult AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS start_date,
    CASE WHEN ca.ancestor_concept_id = 1167322 THEN 'allopurinol' ELSE 'febuxostat' END AS drug
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
  WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id IN (1167322, 19017742)
),
first_ult AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(start_date) AS index_date FROM ult GROUP BY person_id
),
first_drug AS (
  SELECT f.person_id, f.index_date, MIN(u.drug) AS drug
  FROM first_ult f
  JOIN ult u ON u.person_id = f.person_id AND u.start_date = f.index_date
  GROUP BY f.person_id, f.index_date
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT u.drug) = 1
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT fd.person_id, fd.index_date, fd.drug
  FROM first_drug fd
  JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = fd.person_id
  WHERE op.observation_period_start_date <= DATEADD(day, -365, fd.index_date)
    AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day, 365, fd.index_date)
),
gout_desc AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 440674
),
flare AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.person_id
  FROM eligible e
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id = e.person_id
  JOIN gout_desc g ON g.concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE co.condition_start_date > e.index_date
    AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 365, e.index_date)
),
urate AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.person_id
  FROM eligible e
  JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.person_id = e.person_id
  WHERE m.measurement_concept_id IN (3037556, 3026493)
    AND m.measurement_date > e.index_date
    AND m.measurement_date <= DATEADD(day, 365, e.index_date)
),
urate_ctrl AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.person_id
  FROM eligible e
  JOIN omop.measurement m ON m.person_id = e.person_id
  WHERE m.measurement_concept_id = 3037556
    AND m.value_as_number < 6
    AND m.measurement_date > e.index_date
    AND m.measurement_date <= DATEADD(day, 365, e.index_date)
)
SELECT e.drug,
  COUNT(*) AS cohort_n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flare_n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN u.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_urate_test_n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN uc.person_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS urate_ctrl_n
FROM eligible e
LEFT JOIN flare f ON f.person_id = e.person_id
LEFT JOIN urate u ON u.person_id = e.person_id
LEFT JOIN urate_ctrl uc ON uc.person_id = e.person_id
GROUP BY e.drug
ORDER BY e.drug
